translations.免疫需S2发动，不能视为开局常驻免伤。: Immunity requires the skill S2 to be activated, and cannot be regarded as the start of the battle to avoid damage throughout the battle.
translations.免疫需业红队且仅针对晕厥；双自损风险不能忽略。: Immunity requires the red team and is only for syncope; the risk of double self-injury cannot be ignored.
translations.全体440%攻击盾持续3回合、CD4，配合再生；主攻手免控2回合有空窗，治疗作补: Team shields equal to 440% ATK last 3 turns, CD4, with regeneration. The damage dealer’s 2-turn control immunity has gaps; healing supplements protection.
translations.全体常驻减伤15%与闪避15%为主；S2三人治疗按魔力270%，低于15%生命增: Permanent team damage reduction of 15% and EVD of 15% are the main protection. S2 heals 3 allies for 270% MAG, increased to 1.5 times below 15% HP, CD4.
translations.全体来源生命20%及三主攻手70%概率脱力40%为主；S2三次小额治疗，CD4；: Team HP equal to 20% source HP and a 70% chance of 40% Weakness on 3 enemy damage dealers are primary. S2 performs 3 small heals, CD4; recovery boost lasts only 6 turns.
translations.全体防御及主攻手盾为主；S2随机3人净化1种、CD4，P1自身受控才为主攻手净化: Team DEF and the damage dealer’s shield are primary. S2 cleanses 1 debuff from 3 random allies, CD4; P1 cleanses damage dealers only when self is controlled.
translations.共鸣需要多个敌人且目标死亡后解除；单Boss不能按双目标共鸣算。: Resonance requires multiple enemies and is released after the target dies; a single boss cannot be counted as two-target resonance.
translations.关键减冷却与加攻依赖死亡复活；不能计为开局常驻辅助。: The key cooldown reduction and attack power increase rely on death and resurrection; they cannot be counted as assistance at the beginning and last for the entire battle.
translations.其他友军增加生命25%，苍翠再加来源攻击200%；每4行动补4回合再生、每次10: Other allies gain 25% HP, with green allies also gaining 200% source ATK as HP. Regeneration is renewed every 4 actions for 4 turns, restoring 10% max HP per tick.
translations.净化加攻依赖受控，护盾补发依赖队友死亡；防御上限依赖暴击。: debuff removal's attack power improvement depends on controlled, Shield's reissue depends on the death of teammates; the upper limit of defense depends on critical hit.
translations.减冷却、加攻与净化依赖站位；治疗有触发间隔。: Cooldown reduction, attack power increase and debuff removal depend on position; treatment has a trigger interval.
translations.减速不等于阻止行动，低稀有度输出有限。: Slowing down does not mean preventing action, and low rarity output is limited.
translations.减防仍受弱化命中与抗性影响，无专武。: The defense reduction is still affected by debuff hit and resistance, and there is no special weapon.
translations.减防概率未按必定成功计算，缺少专武强化。: The probability of defense reduction is not calculated as a guaranteed success, and there is a lack of special weapon enhancement.
translations.击杀护盾和概率沉默不视为稳定收益；P1速度有助先手。: Killing Shield and probability silence are not considered stable benefits; passive P1 speed helps to act first.
translations.初始稀有度低，治疗倍率较小，侧重前期补位。: The initial rarity is low, the healing multiplier is small, and the focus is on filling positions in the early stage.
translations.力量比较、暴击叠层及护盾状态决定上限；专武回复不能当百分比生命治疗。: Strength comparison, critical hit stacking and Shield status determine the upper limit; special weapon recovery cannot be used as percentage life healing.
translations.加成取奥莉维亚面板而非目标百分比；S2冷却6，暴伤辅助需击杀。: The bonus is based on Olivia's panel rather than the target percentage; skill S2 cooldown 6, critical hit damage assist requires kill.
translations.加攻与净化分支、血量、人数及站位影响辅助收益。: The attack power increase and debuff removal branch, HP, number of people and position affect auxiliary income.
translations.加攻仅自身: Attack power increases only for yourself
translations.加攻暴击仅自身: Attack power increase critical hit only for yourself
translations.加攻需两回合未受伤，控制需要前置弱化且有概率。: To increase the attack power, you need to be uninjured for two rounds, and the control requires debuff in front and has a probability.
translations.历史承伤和自身生命投资决定输出；反伤自身收益高于友军。: Historical damage taken and one's own life investment determine the output; the return from counter-injury is higher than that of friendly forces.
translations.双主动冷却5；强化阻绝要求敌速更低或反伤来源。: Dual active cooldown 5; strengthening damage block requires the enemy speed to be lower or the source of reflected damage.
translations.双主动驱散，成功后给主攻手来源攻击，合理业红目标50%；持续2回合，敌无增益时无: Double active dispersion, after success, it will attack the main attacker from a source, with a reasonable red target 50%; it lasts for 2 rounds, and cannot be triggered when the enemy has no buff.
translations.双目标晕厥要求四名其他业红友军；高倍率依赖多弱化。: Dual target stun requires four other industry red allies; high multiplier relies on multiple debuff.
translations.反伤要求满血并受法师队伍影响，不能按常驻输出。: Counterattack requires full health and is affected by the mage team, and cannot be sustained for the entire battle.
translations.反控只在前两回合积累，五层才能触发，不能当常驻群控。: Counter-control is only accumulated in the first two rounds and can be triggered at the fifth level. It cannot be used as group control that lasts the entire battle.
translations.各目标低血存活后仅一次400%攻击治疗与2种净化；主攻手防护、受魔攻群净化仅前6: Each target gets a one-time heal equal to 400% ATK and removal of 2 debuffs after surviving at low HP. Damage-dealer protection and magic-hit group cleansing last only the first 6 turns.
translations.合理配队仅第4、8、12回合末为主攻手净化2种；开局无保护，不能当连续解控。: With an appropriate team, the damage dealer is cleansed of 2 debuffs only at the ends of turns 4, 8 and 12. No opening protection or continuous control removal.
translations.后期爆发与前期吸血错开；屏障再触发间隔8次行动。: The later outbreak is staggered with the early stage HP Drain; Barrier is triggered again at an interval of 8 actions.
translations.吸血依赖造成伤害，叠攻依赖暴击。: HP Drain relies on critical hit to cause damage, and stack attacks rely on critical hit.
translations.命中提升同时降低闪避50%；攻击加成取科迪面板且有周期。: The hit is increased and the dodge is reduced 50%; the attack bonus takes the Cody panel and has a period.
translations.团队保护限忧蓝；S1自降速度，满层依赖受弱化或控制。: Team protection is limited to worry blue; the skill S1 automatically reduces the speed, and the full layer dependence is controlled by debuff or control.
translations.团队抗暴要求敌人仍有5名，击杀后解除；辅助后期才增强。: Team CRIT RES chance requires that the enemy still has 5 name, which will be released after killing; it will only be enhanced in the later stage of assistance.
translations.复制收益随队友变化；高伤需三次施放，塔和推图减防规则不同。: The copy benefit changes with teammates; high damage requires three casts, and the defense reduction rules for towers and push maps are different.
translations.复制类型不固定，战技比较与敌方增益影响效果，不能预设复制硬控。: The type of copy is not fixed, and the comparison of combat skills with the enemy buff affects the effect. Copy hard control cannot be preset.
translations.复活反击依赖历史承伤；残血双倍和击杀群攻均有条件。: Resurrection and counterattack rely on historical damage; there are conditions for double low health and kill group attack.
translations.复活每战一次；增攻加速短暂，弱化和血量影响伤害。输出降低基础施加概率50%，魔力: Resurrection occurs once per battle; the attack acceleration is short-lived, and debuff and HP affect the damage. The output reduces the basic application probability 50%, when the magic power is higher than the target 100%; it is not calculated independently 15% and the final damage received is reduced.
translations.多敌中毒与长回合放大输出；单Boss不能计九连击上限。: Multiple enemies are poisoned and the output is amplified in a long round; a single boss cannot count towards the nine-hit combo limit.
translations.天赋续期需三名弱化敌人；S1强削弱需业红队。: Talent renewal requires three debuff enemies; skill S1 requires a red team to strengthen and weaken.
translations.对射手必中特化，死亡增攻和隐身维持均有条件。: It is specialized for shooters who must hit, and there are conditions for increased attack upon death and maintenance of invisibility.
translations.开局忧蓝500%攻击盾持续6回合、仅一次；受击后30%净化1种作补充，S1降低友: Opening blue-ally shields equal 500% ATK, last 6 turns and occur once. Post-attack 30% chance to cleanse 1 debuff is supplementary; S1 reduces allied lifesteal.
translations.开局攻命速只持续2回合；击杀加攻减冷却与存活重放不同条件。: The attack speed at the beginning only lasts for 2 rounds; the attack power of the kill is increased and the cooldown is reduced, and the conditions for survival replay are different.
translations.强伤需第四次S2，流金队加快成长，护盾第13回合后不再触发。按攻击:生命=1:3: Strong damage requires the fourth skill S2, which speeds up the growth of the Golden Team. Shield will no longer be triggered after the 13 round. According to the rough reference of attack:life=1:3, a single 1000% attack shield is about 333% life shield; the actual attack/life is the current attack/life, and multiple shields cannot be stacked to last the entire battle life.
translations.强依赖自损叠层；控制属性受限，开局增益只持续两回合。: Strong reliance on self-damage stacks; limited control attributes, starting buff only lasts two rounds.
translations.强减伤及增伤需致命触发；屏障补偿依赖当回合抵消记录。: Strong damage reduction and damage increase require fatal triggering; Barrier compensation relies on the offset record of the current round.
translations.强化普攻三人各回10%最大生命，仅10回合；原生命至少50%才解控，S1第7回合: Enhanced normal attacks heal 3 allies for 10% max HP each, lasting only 10 turns. Control is removed only if initial HP is at least 50%; S1 healing stops from turn 7.
translations.强化消耗受击层数；自身恶化会提高所受持续伤害。: Strengthening consumes the number of hit layers; self-deterioration will increase the continuous damage received.
translations.强输出需多次施放；额外净化频次要求流金队，不能当常态群体保护。: Strong output needs to be cast multiple times; additional debuff removal frequency requires a golden team and cannot be used as normal group protection.
translations.抗暴降低随睡眠受击解除，未当持续增伤: CRIT RES chance The reduction is removed when sleeping, and the damage caused by continuous damage is increased.
translations.护盾和治疗受来源面板影响；免控存在周期，反伤不按稳定输出。: Shield and treatment are affected by the source panel; there is no need to control the existence period, and the counter-injury does not have a stable output.
translations.挑衅按保护作用计入团队防护，不等同阻止行动: Provocation counts towards team protection as a protective effect and is not equivalent to preventing actions.
translations.挑衅需高血且降低闪避；受致命伤时不能触发专武回复。: Provocation requires high health and reduced dodge; special weapon recovery cannot be triggered when fatally wounded.
translations.控制依赖力量比较；追加伤害要求敌方生命低于20%。: Control relies on strength comparison; additional damage requires the enemy's health to be lower than 20%.
translations.控制依赖概率和站位；减伤仅在30%生命以下。: The control depends on probability and position; the damage taken is reduced only below 30%'s life.
translations.推图可提前获得强辅助，其他模式需第9回合；无跨场景综合总分。: Push pictures to get strong assistance in advance, other modes require the 9 round; there is no cross-scenario comprehensive score.
translations.收益依赖优妮生命面板及战斗长度；秘仪不计入个人评分。: The income depends on Uni's life panel and the length of the battle; the secret ritual is not included in the personal score.
translations.攻击增益需累积，治疗只到第6回合；第7回合后轮转改变。吸血需先存活并造成有效伤害: The attack buff needs to be accumulated, and the treatment only lasts until the 6 round; the rotation changes after the 7 round. HP Drain needs to survive and cause effective damage first, and does not rely on anti-burst or stability to independently bear damage to reduce bonus points.
translations.攻击辅助限忧蓝且依赖五种弱化；S1自降防御。: The attack auxiliary is limited to blue and relies on five debuff; the skill S1 automatically lowers defense.
translations.敌方免疫会影响控制却触发全体护盾；输出需长战斗。: The enemy's immunity will affect the control but trigger all Shield; the output requires a long battle.
translations.斩杀同时要求生命比例和绝对生命门槛；专武暴伤依赖击杀。: Execution requires both life ratio and absolute life threshold; the damage of Special Weapon critical hit depends on kill.
translations.无友军增伤、加攻、加速、减防或驱散等进攻辅助。: No offensive support such as ally damage, ATK or speed buffs, defense reduction or dispelling.
translations.无友军进攻增益或敌方防御削弱: No friendly attacks buff or enemy defense weakened
translations.无团队增益或伤害放大: No Team buff or damage amplification
translations.无攻击增益或敌方削弱: No attack buff or enemy weakening
translations.无沉默、晕厥、减速等行动干扰。: No Silence, Stun, SPD reduction or other action disruption.
translations.无直接友军进攻增益或敌方防御削弱: No direct friendly attack buff or enemy defense weakened
translations.无直接团队增益；抗暴降低随睡眠受击解除: No direct team buff; CRIT RES chance reduction is canceled when sleeping
translations.无直接团队进攻增益；减速仅计行动干扰: No direct team attack buff; slowdown only counts as action interference
translations.无直接行动限制；不治归入进攻辅助: No direct action restrictions; cannot recover HP is classified as an offensive support
translations.无直接行动限制；减疗归入进攻辅助: No direct action restrictions; reduced healing is classified as offensive support
translations.无直接行动限制；吸血降低归入进攻辅助并注明负面协同: No direct action restrictions; HP Drain is reduced to offensive support and marked with negative synergy
translations.无直接行动限制；增益免疫归入进攻辅助: No direct action restrictions; buff immunity is classified as an offensive support
translations.无直接进攻增益；减速仅计行动干扰: No direct attack buff; slowdown only counts as movement interference
translations.无直接进攻辅助；S1输出伤害下降计入团队防护: No direct offensive support; the reduced output damage of skill S1 is included in team protection
translations.无直接进攻辅助；减攻计入团队防护: No direct offensive support; reduced attack power is included in team protection
translations.无直接进攻辅助；减攻计防护，减速计行动干扰: No direct attack assistance; attack power reduction meter for protection, deceleration meter for action interference
translations.无直接进攻辅助；减速仅计行动干扰: No direct attack assistance; deceleration only counts as movement interference
translations.无直接进攻辅助；减速计入行动干扰: No direct attack assistance; deceleration counts as action interference
translations.无直接进攻辅助；弱化命中降低计入团队防护: No direct offensive support; debuff hit reduction is included in team protection
translations.无直接进攻辅助；敌方攻击和弱化命中降低计入团队防护: No direct offensive support; enemy attack and debuff hit reduction count towards team protection
translations.无直接进攻辅助；敌方暴伤降低计入团队防护: No direct attack support; enemy critical hit damage reduction is included in team protection
translations.无直接进攻辅助；脱力和贯通降低计入团队防护: No direct offensive support; Weakened and penetration are reduced and counted towards team protection
translations.无直接进攻辅助；脱力属于团队防护: No direct offensive support; Weakened belongs to team protection
translations.无直接进攻辅助；非射手减速计入行动干扰: No direct offensive assistance; non-shooter slowdown counts as action interference
translations.无直接队友进攻增益；吸攻的自益计输出，削弱计防护: No direct teammate attack buff; Self-benefit meter output by absorbing attack, weakening meter protection
translations.无行动干扰；禁锢仅使目标无法闪避，不限制行动。: No action disruption; Bind only prevents targets from evading and does not restrict actions.
translations.暂定评分：当前MB缺少专武被动属性，暂按无额外专武属性计算。流金护盾强化按合理配: Provisional rating: the current MB lacks weapon passive stats, so no extra weapon stats are assumed. Enhanced Amber Shields assume a suitable team. Shield grants stop early, while high S2 multipliers require casts 3/4. M.DEF reduction must apply successfully. Turn-start Shield and ATK ordering is unconfirmed, so the opening Shield excludes Holy Guidance ATK.
translations.暴击、残血暴率与击杀决定上限；开局护盾非循环保护。: critical hit, low HP critical hit rate and kills determine the upper limit; Shield non-cyclic protection at the beginning.
translations.暴击影响净化数和再生时长；自身弱化缩短会消耗保护回合。: critical hit affects the number of debuff removal and the regeneration time; shortening the debuff itself will consume the protection round.
translations.最高专武攻击+18%、防御穿透7000与物魔防御穿透7000已计入。高血最快第5: Highest exclusive weapon ATK +18%, DEF penetration 7000 and P/M DEF penetration 7000 included. High HP reaches full stacks at turn 5 earliest; full-stack follow-ups are not assumed at opening. Strength-based direct hits explicitly guarantee criticals, using base CRIT damage only; no extra ATK, defense paths or unconfirmed damage bonus applies.
translations.最高专武攻击+18%、防御穿透7000已计入；力量+8%不擅自换成攻击。P1仅第: The highest weapon’s +18% ATK and 7000 DEF penetration are included; +8% STR is not converted into assumed ATK. P1 resolves actual turn-1 self-damage only in turn 2. Full ATK and enhanced S2 are conditional references. The 2-turn damage-taken increase assumes at least 2 other Crimson allies. The ward lasts only the opening 3 turns.
translations.最高专武攻击+18%已计入；弱化抗性与抗暴评级不折固定减伤。P2生命条件按至少2: Highest exclusive weapon ATK +18% included; debuff and CRIT resistance ratings are not converted into fixed damage reduction. P2 assumes at least 2 other same-element or Radiance allies in a suitable team. The 15-event counter counts active healing only, excluding lifesteal and passive healing from Holy Sword’s Light.
translations.最高增伤要求当回合多次受击；低速选择与站位影响搭配。: The maximum damage increase requires multiple hits in the round; low speed selection and positioning influence are combined.
translations.核心辅助在S2，收益集中于最高攻击目标；自保依赖血量。: The core auxiliary skill is S2, and the income is concentrated on the highest attack target; self-protection depends on HP.
translations.核心输出第7回合启动，回血随苍翠队人数增长且每回合限次。: The core output starts in the 7 round, and the life restored increases with the number of Green Team members and is limited to each round.
translations.残血双倍和击杀加攻不默认满足；减防受命中抗性限制。80%减防的增伤收益随敌防与贯: The double HP and the attack power increase on kill are not satisfied by default; the defense power reduction is limited by hit resistance. 80% The damage increase benefit caused by reduced defense changes with the enemy's defense and penetration, and is not regarded as a fixed 80% damage increase.
translations.残香需弱化队累积，开局速度加成要求三同属性。: The residual fragrance needs to be accumulated by the debuff team, and the starting speed bonus requires three attributes.
translations.沙尘概率、敌方血量和目标防御决定收益；冷却重置每战一次。: The probability of dust, enemy health and target defense determine the income; the cooldown is reset once per battle.
translations.治疗与沉默分属前后期；叠攻依赖主动恢复。: Treatment and silence belong to the early and late stages respectively; stacked attacks rely on active recovery.
translations.治疗依赖魔力及残血；追加伤害随命中目标总伤变化。: Treatment relies on magic power and low health; additional damage varies with the total damage of the target hit.
translations.治疗要求自身低于60%且依赖输出；反伤不等于减伤。: The treatment requires itself to be lower than 60% and relies on output; counter-injury does not mean reduced damage received.
translations.满层依赖主动恢复队；保护增强限苍翠。: The full layer relies on the active recovery team; the protection enhancement is limited to green.
translations.灵魂献祭需15层记忆且后续不再叠加，不能当每次S2都有强化辅助。: Soul Sacrifice requires 15 layers of memory and will not be superimposed later. It cannot be used as a strengthening aid for each skill S2.
translations.爆发需20次暴击计数；团队保护限幽冥，混色队明显降低。: The explosion requires 20 critical hit counts; team protection is limited to Netherworld, and the mixed-color team is significantly reduced.
translations.爆发需要恢复队累计15次主动治疗；受致命攻击不能回复。: The outbreak requires the recovery team to accumulate 15 active treatments; it cannot recover from fatal attacks.
translations.献身仅首行动起3回合，防御辅助要求友军更快；加速需不超过两种属性。: Devotion only takes 3 turns for the first action. Defense support requires allies to be faster; acceleration requires no more than two attributes.
translations.生命比例伤害不可暴击且有上限；驱散、控制均有概率。: Life-proportional damage cannot be critical hit and has an upper limit; both dispersion and control have probabilities.
translations.目标按增益数而非攻击选择；减伤续期和自身加攻需增益队。: The target is selected based on buff number rather than attack; the renewal of damage reduction and own attack power increase require buff team.
translations.睡眠会被攻击解除；晕厥依赖魔力比较，屏障有再触发间隔。: Sleep will be released by attacks; Fainted depends on magic power comparison, Barrier has a retrigger interval.
translations.站位、速度与暴击影响控制；弱化抗性不等同绝对免疫。: Position, speed and critical hit affect control; debuff resistance is not the same as absolute immunity.
translations.第7回合S1为两名主攻手加攻/暴率各40%；前期各10%，成熟收益相乘但启动晚。: The skill S1 in the 7 round is 40% each for the attack power increase/critical hit rate of the two main attackers; each 10% in the early stage, the mature benefits are multiplied but the startup is late.

translations.高辅助限业红苍翠；开局加速2回合，净化要求至少两种弱化。: High auxiliary limit is red and green; the start speeds up 2 rounds, debuff removal requires at least two debuff.
translations.高输出依赖残血、追击或法师目标；不死每战仅触发一次。: High output relies on low health, pursuit or mage targets; surviving at 1 HP only triggers once per battle.
translations.高速有利先手；减速不是硬控，叠层和魔力比较影响收益。: High speed is beneficial to act first; slowing down is not a hard control, stacking and magic power will affect the income.
translations.高速有利先行保护；紧急护盾有4次行动间隔。: High speed is beneficial to advance protection; emergency Shield has 4 action intervals.
translations.魔力、目标血量、自身弱化决定分支；两主动冷却均5。: Magic power, target HP, and own debuff determine the branch; both active cooldowns are 5.
translations.魔力直接伤害不能与攻击倍率简单相加；命中专武提高稳定性。: Magic power direct damage cannot be simply added to the attack multiplier; hit-specific weaponry improves stability.
